title: Chapter 188 Is There Anyone Else?
content:
Chapter 188 Is There Anyone Else?

Everyone formed a defensive formation and continued to advance.

After pushing open the heavy door, everyone carefully stepped into the underground palace.

In the huge palace, a throne stood on a high platform directly in front. In the center of the hall, there was a carpet, and there were some stone tables on both sides near the stone pillars.

It can be seen that it should be the table where guests serve fruit and wine during a banquet.

Wang Shuo stepped on the carpet, and the carpet under his feet immediately turned into ashes.

Apparently it has become corrupted due to the erosion of time!

The walls around the hall are carved with exquisite murals, but there are no brilliant colors.

The true nature of the building materials is revealed. It looks a bit simple and loses the sense of splendor, but it still cannot conceal its solemnity.

Just as everyone was observing the situation around them, a black shadow rushed over.

Although the black shadow was very fast, Wang Shuo's agility was already very high and he still captured its figure.

This monster is 1 meter long, shaped like a hunting dog, with sharp fangs and monkey-like limbs. It can stand and walk, and has sharp claws on its limbs.

There was no trace of flesh and blood on his body, and his whole body was shrouded in a faint black death aura.

Wang Shuo used the "Eye of Deception" skill to investigate.

【Underworld Beast】

[Level: Level 28]

[Attack power: 300]

[Defense: 80]

[Health value: 6600]

[An alien beast eroded by death energy, good at sneak attacks. 】

No wonder, when Wang Shuo was only at level 4, he would be chased by such a monster and run away in embarrassment.

At this moment, the levels of Wang Shuo and others are already above level 25, and the level difference with this monster is almost negligible.

Wang Shuo even felt confident that he could challenge it alone.

In order to avenge the past, Wang Shuo decided.

Or gang fight it.

Gong Zheng resisted the damage head-on.

The underworld beast slapped its claws on the shield, and Gong Zheng barely lost any health points.

But back then, its claw almost killed Gong Zheng.

Wang Shuo couldn't help but be filled with emotion.

It’s really thirty years to the east of Hedong and thirty years to the west of Hexi.

Now, killing this underworld beast is just a joke.

After a while, the underworld beast was killed and several energy crystals exploded.

The danger was initially lifted, but everyone did not relax their vigilance.

Wang Shuo was worried that there might be more than one underworld beast in this place.

Sure enough, after a while, another underworld beast rushed over and gave Wang Shuo a few energy crystals.

After Wang Shuo figured out the situation at hand, there were two roads in front of them.

On the left and right sides of the throne, there are two paths leading to the back.

Wang Shuo walked across the edge of the carpet, and the system prompt sounded.

[You are about to enter the Dragon King Underground Palace dungeon. The maximum number of people who can enter this dungeon is 50. The number of people who can currently enter is 46. Are you sure to enter? 】

Wang Shuo quickly retracted his left foot.

He was confused and confused.

First, this copy actually has a limit on the number of people.

Second, there were actually four people inside.

Wang Shuo was a little confused as to whether these four people were players or others.

Out of caution, he turned around and returned to the square.

After explaining the size of the territory to Duan Wenxi and others, from all the soldiers.

40 people were selected, including Black Mountain Bandits, Archers, Ballista Battalion, and Golden Fire Cavalry, with 10 people from each type.

Counting Gong Zheng, Ayub, Li Jianguo, Gu Liji, Bai Liliang and Wang Shuo himself, there are exactly 46 people.

As for Gong Kai and others, they are responsible for the defense of the territory.

After the arrangements were made, Wang Shuo returned to the Dragon King's Underground Palace again.

[The number of people meets the requirements, are you sure to enter the Dragon King’s Underground Palace? 】

"yes."

At this time, Wang Shuo and others crossed the edge of the carpet without any hindrance, the seemingly non-existent obstacle.

Two passages appeared in front of him.

Wang Shuo asked Chang Gui.

"Agui, which way do you think we should go?"

"Lord, I suggest you go to the right."

"Okay, then let's go to the left."

Chang Gui: "..."
